description.value: Texas Smoke BBQ is a mobile, wood-smoked BBQ operation based in the Fraser Valley, specializing in authentic Texas-style slow-smoked meats — brisket, ribs, pulled pork, and sausages cooked low and slow over wood. They rotate between several fixed venue partners across Langley, Vancouver, and Surrey (including Barnes Harley-Davidson and Potters Nursery), and also offer full-service event catering and pre-order platters with 48-hour notice. A picnic area is available at at least some stops, making it a legitimate mid-ride fuel option in the Lower Mainland.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this 'Texas BBQ' and tags it as a restaurant, but the discovered website (texassmokebbq.ca) belongs to 'Texas Smoke BBQ,' a mobile food truck and catering operation — the URL discovery notes already flag this name discrepancy. The website FAQ explicitly states 'We operate as a mobile BBQ and catering service' and 'We run food trucks and cater events,' with no fixed restaurant address; the contact page lists four rotating venue partners in Langley, Vancouver, and Surrey. Gluten-free options are confirmed via the FAQ page; no bike parking, water refill, washroom, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Texas BBQ' but the website and all branding use 'Texas Smoke BBQ'. OSM record likely needs a name correction.

OSM tags this as a fixed 'restaurant' but the business is a mobile food truck operating at rotating venue partners with no fixed address. The OSM pin location may not reliably correspond to an active service location.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active food truck business confirmed by a live website with reviews, menus, and current venue listings across the Lower Mainland — a useful fuelling stop for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: Venue partners listed on the contact page as of the website fetch: Barnes Harley Davidson (8859 201 St, Langley BC), Milner Feeds (21565 Crush Crescent, Langley BC), Trev Deeley HD (1875 Boundary Road, Vancouver BC), Potters Nursery (19158 48 Ave, Surrey BC).
